activation_collect_dg_sound.why: Main-statements appendix: a solved D/G table satisfies the coverage obligations.

compile.simps(4).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (Seq c1.0 c2.0) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) =
       compile \<Pi> p c1.0 (Statement (n + csize c1.0)) n;
     (n2, en2, E2, K2) = compile \<Pi> p c2.0 k (n + csize c1.0)
 in (n2, en1, E1 \<union> E2, K1 \<union> K2))
compile.simps(4).why: Program-model chapter: compiling a sequence hands the first command the second's entry.

compile.simps(5).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (gcom.If i b c1.0 c2.0) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) = compile \<Pi> p c1.0 k (Suc n);
     (n2, en2, E2, K2) = compile \<Pi> p c2.0 k n1
 in (n2, Statement n,
     {(Statement n, EA_Assume b, if is_SKIP c1.0 then k else en1),
      (Statement n, EA_AssumeNot b,
       if is_SKIP c2.0 then k else en2)} \<union>
     (if is_SKIP c1.0 then {} else E1) \<union>
     (if is_SKIP c2.0 then {} else E2),
     K1 \<union> K2))
compile.simps(5).why: Program-model chapter: both branches of a conditional compile against one continuation.

compile.simps(6).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (While i b c) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) = compile \<Pi> p c (Statement n) (Suc n)
 in (n1, Statement n,
     {(Statement n, EA_Assume b, en1),
      (Statement n, EA_AssumeNot b, k)} \<union>
     E1,
     K1))
compile.simps(6).why: Program-model chapter: a loop body compiles against the loop head.

compile.simps(8).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (Return i e) k n =
(Suc n, Statement n, {(Statement n, EA_Ret e p, FunctionResult p)}, {})
compile.simps(8).why: Program-model chapter: a return edge targets the procedure's result node.

csim_star.statement:
\<lbrakk>\<Pi>,g,\<rho> \<turnstile> (c, s, frs) \<approx> (v, t, stk);
 procs_embedded \<Pi> g; return_safe c;
 star (vimp_sem.gpstep ev glob rv conv \<Pi>) (c, s, frs) src'\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>cfg'.
                     star (cfg_exec_sem.gcstep ev rv conv glob g)
                      (v, t, stk) cfg' \<and>
                     \<Pi>,g,\<rho> \<turnstile> src' \<approx> cfg'
csim_star.why: Main-statements appendix: simulation of source runs by the compiled graph.

csim_step.statement:
\<lbrakk>\<Pi>,g,\<rho> \<turnstile> (c, s, frs) \<approx> (v, t, stk);
 procs_embedded \<Pi> g; return_safe c;
 vimp_sem.gpstep ev glob rv conv \<Pi> (c, s, frs) src'\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>cfg'.
                     star (cfg_exec_sem.gcstep ev rv conv glob g)
                      (v, t, stk) cfg' \<and>
                     \<Pi>,g,\<rho> \<turnstile> src' \<approx> cfg'
csim_step.why: Program-model chapter: one source step is matched by the compiled graph.

gpstep.Call.statement:
\<lbrakk>\<Pi> p = Some decl; length actuals = length (formals decl);
 distinct (formals decl); vals = map (\<lambda>e. ev e s) actuals;
 callee =
 bind_formals (formals decl)
  (map2 (\<lambda>x. conv (Some x)) (formals decl) vals)
  (enter_state glob s)\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> vimp_sem.gpstep ev glob rv conv \<Pi>
                   (gcom.Call i dst p actuals, s, frs)
                   (Seq (body decl) (Restore i), callee, Frame s dst # frs)
gpstep.Call.why: Program-model chapter: the source step rule for a call.

gpstep.RestoreStep.statement:
vimp_sem.gpstep ev glob rv conv \<Pi> (Restore i, s, Frame fr dst # frs)
 (SKIP i, combine_assign dst (conv dst (s rv)) (combine_env glob fr s), frs)
gpstep.RestoreStep.why: Program-model chapter: the source step rule that restores the caller's frame.

gpstep.ReturnSome.statement:
vimp_sem.gpstep ev glob rv conv \<Pi> (Return i (Some e), s, frs)
 (Unwind i, s(rv := ev e s), frs)
gpstep.ReturnSome.why: Program-model chapter: the source step rule for returning a value.

gpstep.UnwindAct.statement:
vimp_sem.gpstep ev glob rv conv \<Pi>
 (Seq (Unwind j) (Restore i), s, Frame fr dst # frs)
 (SKIP i, combine_assign dst (conv dst (s rv)) (combine_env glob fr s), frs)
gpstep.UnwindAct.why: Program-model chapter: the source step rule that pops the caller's frame after an explicit return.

mcp_combine_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>\<forall>(\<gamma>\<^sub>i, c\<^sub>i)\<in>set comps.
            mcp_sem.gsound_local_spec ev rv conv glob \<gamma>\<^sub>i

 mcp_independent comps; comps \<noteq> []\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> mcp_sem.gsound_local_spec ev rv conv glob
                   (mcp_gamma (map fst comps)) (mcp_combine (map snd comps))
mcp_combine_sound.why: Cooperation chapter: independent sound components combine into a sound component.

nv_source_certified.statement:
\<exists>res v stk.
   run_voblint nv_conf [] nv_prog = Analysed res \<and>
   map (\<lambda>chk. (check_point chk, check_verdict chk))
    (report_checks res) =
   [(Statement 4, Decided Check_Proved),
    (Statement 5, Decided Check_Proved)] \<and>
   elab_ptable nv_prog [],elab_cfg nv_prog [],prog_main_name \<turnstile>
   (nv_checks, nv_final, []) \<approx> (v, nv_final, stk) \<and>
   nv_final \<in> reaching [] nv_prog v \<and>
   (\<exists>d.
       Lifted d \<in> report_states_at res v \<and>
       nv_final
       \<in> mcp.act_gamma [] (activation_of (conf_analyses nv_conf))
              d) \<and>
   \<not> DEAD res v
nv_source_certified.why: Non-vacuity section of the evaluation: the endpoint's premises hold for one program.

routed_node_rhs_buffered_parts.statement:
(\<And>w.
    \<forall>p\<in>set (routed_contribution_programs pred_sel site_sel route
                         it cmb extra g c w).
       sp_wf p) \<Longrightarrow>
eq (routed_node_rhs_buffered pred_sel site_sel buffer_key_at route it cmb
     extra g bot0.0 d\<^sub>0 g\<^sub>0)
 (v, c) \<tau> =
DG (rhs_init g bot0.0 d\<^sub>0 v \<squnion>
    (\<Squnion>(u,
        a)\<leftarrow>pred_sel g v c. rhs_edge it \<tau> c u a) \<squnion>
    (\<Squnion>(u,
        ca)\<leftarrow>site_sel g
                        v. rhs_call cmb route \<tau> c u ca v) \<squnion>
    rhs_seed extra route \<tau> c v)
 \<bottom>
routed_node_rhs_buffered_parts.why: Chapter 8, interprocedural equations: the executed buffered generator answers the same join of parts as the reference generator.

run_voblint_check_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>run_voblint conf ds p = Analysed res;
 s0.0 \<in> init_stores (kenv_of ds);
 kenv_of ds,elab_ptable p ds \<turnstile>
 (main_body (elab_ptable p ds), s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs);
 next_check residual = Some (l, e)\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>c\<in>set (report_checks res).
                     check_label c = l \<and>
                     check_exp c = e \<and>
                     s \<in> reaching ds p (check_point c) \<and>
                     check_verdict c \<noteq> Dead \<and>
                     (check_verdict c =
                      Decided Check_Proved \<longrightarrow>
                      truthy (eval e s)) \<and>
                     (check_verdict c =
                      Decided Check_Refuted \<longrightarrow>
                      \<not> truthy (eval e s))
run_voblint_check_sound.why: Check-verdict endpoint cited in the introduction.

run_voblint_dead_unreached.statement:

\<Longrightarrow> reaching ds p v = {}
run_voblint_dead_unreached.why: Unreachability endpoint cited in the introduction.

run_voblint_report_contract.statement:
run_voblint conf ds p = Analysed res \<Longrightarrow>
valid_activation (conf_analyses conf)
run_voblint conf ds p = Analysed res \<Longrightarrow>
wf_program_compile_input_exec p
run_voblint conf ds p = Analysed res \<Longrightarrow>
report_config res = conf
run_voblint conf ds p = Analysed res \<Longrightarrow>
report_cfg res = elab_cfg p ds
run_voblint_report_contract.why: Results chapter: what an analysed answer guarantees about its report.

run_voblint_source_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>run_voblint conf ds p = Analysed res;
 s0.0 \<in> init_stores (kenv_of ds);
 kenv_of ds,elab_ptable p ds \<turnstile>
 (main_body (elab_ptable p ds), s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs)\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>v stk.
                     elab_ptable p
                      ds,elab_cfg p ds,prog_main_name \<turnstile>
                     (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk) \<and>
                     s \<in> reaching ds p v \<and>
                     (\<exists>d.
                         Lifted d \<in> report_states_at res v \<and>
                         s \<in> mcp.act_gamma ds
                                  (activation_of (conf_analyses conf))
                                  d) \<and>
                     \<not> DEAD res v \<and>
                     (\<forall>c.
                         PROVED res v c \<longrightarrow>
                         truthy (eval c s)) \<and>
                     (\<forall>c.
                         REFUTED res v c \<longrightarrow>
                         \<not> truthy (eval c s)) \<and>
                     (SAFE res v \<longrightarrow>
                      (\<forall>ob\<in>obligations_at ds p v.
                          s \<Turnstile> ob))
run_voblint_source_sound.why: The introduction states the source-level soundness result with its actual premises.

run_voblint_spine.statement:
\<lbrakk>run_voblint conf ds p = Analysed res;
 s0.0 \<in> init_stores (kenv_of ds);
 kenv_of ds,elab_ptable p ds \<turnstile>
 (main_body (elab_ptable p ds), s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs);
 \<And>t.
    t \<in> \<T>\<^bsub>kenv_of
                         ds,elab_cfg p
                             ds,init_stores
                                 (kenv_of ds)\<^esub> \<Longrightarrow>
    \<exists>c.
       vimp.gactivation_context_rel (kenv_of ds) adm c\<^sub>0
        (elab_cfg p ds) t c;
 \<And>v.
    \<Union>
     (range
       (\<A>\<^bsub>kenv_of
                     ds,adm,c\<^sub>0,elab_cfg p
 ds,init_stores (kenv_of ds)\<^esub>
         v)) =
    reaching ds p v\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>v stk t c.
                     elab_ptable p
                      ds,elab_cfg p ds,prog_main_name \<turnstile>
                     (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk) \<and>
                     vimp.gactivation_trace_repr (kenv_of ds)
                      (elab_cfg p ds) (init_stores (kenv_of ds)) (v, s, stk)
                      t \<and>
                     vimp.gactivation_context_rel (kenv_of ds) adm c\<^sub>0
                      (elab_cfg p ds) t c \<and>
                     s \<in> \<A>\<^bsub>kenv_of
    ds,adm,c\<^sub>0,elab_cfg p ds,init_stores (kenv_of ds)\<^esub>
                              v c \<and>
                     \<Union>
                      (range
                        (\<A>\<^bsub>kenv_of
ds,adm,c\<^sub>0,elab_cfg p ds,init_stores (kenv_of ds)\<^esub>
                          v)) =
                     reaching ds p v \<and>
                     (\<exists>d.
                         Lifted d \<in> report_states_at res v \<and>
                         s \<in> mcp.act_gamma ds
                                  (activation_of (conf_analyses conf))
                                  d) \<and>
                     (\<forall>c.
                         PROVED res v c \<longrightarrow>
                         truthy (eval c s)) \<and>
                     (\<forall>c.
                         REFUTED res v c \<longrightarrow>
                         \<not> truthy (eval c s))
run_voblint_spine.why: Results chapter: a source run's trace, its context and the chain to the verdicts, once for every policy.

source_progress.statement:
\<lbrakk>gwf_source_program vars rv glob \<Pi>;
 star (vimp_sem.gpstep ev glob rv conv \<Pi>) (main_body \<Pi>, s0.0, [])
  (c, s, frs)\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> is_SKIP c \<and> frs = [] \<or>
                  (\<exists>cfg'.
                      vimp_sem.gpstep ev glob rv conv \<Pi> (c, s, frs)
                       cfg')
source_progress.why: Program-model chapter: reachable configurations of a well-formed program are finished or can step.
